evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.MCL: Mild to moderate sprain of the medial collateral ligament with focal thickening and heterogeneous signal intensity at the proximal fibers, and edema surrounding the mid to distal fibers.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complex medial meniscal tears including an oblique component at the posterior horn extending to the free edge.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Mild intrasubstance heterogeneous signal intensity in the body without definite tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Moderate to advanced medial compartment osteoarthritis with areas of to grade 4 chondrosis in the medial femoral condyle.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.PF OA: Moderate patellofemoral osteoarthritis with areas of grade 2/3 chondrosis.
evidence.Contusion: There is a stress fracture of the medial tibial plateau with curvilinear low signal intensity in the subcortical bone measuring up to 1.0 cm anterior posterior by 0.9 cm mediolateral dimension with surrounding marrow edema.
evidence.Fracture: Stress fracture of the medial tibial plateau measuring approximately 0.9 x 1.0 cm with surrounding marrow edema.
